Live Escape can be found on the top floor of Oppidium Shopping Center; we share the entrance with JumpXL. 
Working hours are flexible according to the principle of "self-scheduling.

You will also have to reset the escape rooms to make them ready for the next group and occasionally handle a vacuum and mop. 
Groups typically consist of 3 to 8 people. 
Our last time slot is 22:15 / 23:15 so a workday lasts until 23:45 at most. You are never alone on the weekends. Good command of Dutch and English is necessary.

Picnic is built on a simple promise: groceries ordered through an app, at a fair price, delivered to the door. In fresh produce, it recently raised the bar: premium quality as a competitive edge. The Senior Buyer Fruit & Vegetables translates that ambition into what lands in the app every day, setting and upholding the quality standard across the category. Picnic vacatures 
 About Picnic 
Picnic launched in the Netherlands in 2015 with a pilot of twelve Electric Picnic Vehicles in Amersfoort. Two years later, that number had already grown to a hundred, and expansion has continued ever since, making Picnic one of Europe's fastest-growing online grocers. Today, thousands of recognizable red vehicles operate across the Netherlands, France, and Germany, delivering daily groceries to millions of customers. Backed by investors including Edeka and the Gates Foundation, Picnic has raised close to two billion euros to fund its continued growth. Much of what makes the model work is built in-house, from the software powering its fully automated fulfillment centers to its all-electric delivery fleet. 
The organization now employs more than fifteen thousand people from over eighty nationalities. Beneath its scale, it still runs with the mindset of the startup it once was. The hierarchy remains flat, and people are trusted with real responsibility from day one. The office culture is energetic, with many employees working on site at its Amsterdam office, drawn by the lively atmosphere (and several office dogs) and a constant drive to keep improving every day.

In this role, you will operate a reach truck, handle raw materials, and organize finished products for shipment. From time to time, you will also transport products to and from the freezer. Don't worry, we provide all the protective clothing you need to stay warm.

You must be able to communicate in either Dutch or English.

You will work from Monday to Friday in a two-shift schedule. The morning shift runs from 06:00 to 15:00, and the evening shift runs from 14:00 to 23:00.

For all hours worked between 18:00 and 23:00, you will receive a 133% shift allowance. In addition, you will receive extra compensation for working in the freezer.

Your starting salary is €18,38 per hour, including ADV and the freezer allowance. During the applicable evening shift hours, your hourly wage increases to €23,84

- Valid Reach Truck Certificate
- Reach truck driving experience is an advantage

Imagine starting your day in a buzzing warehouse where no two days are ever the same. As a Warehouse Operative, you’ll become part of an enthusiastic and supportive team that keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes. From the moment products arrive until they’re on their way to customers, you’ll play a key role in making it all happen.

You’ll move between different departments. Sometimes you’re receiving goods in inbound, other times you’re carefully picking and packing orders that need to go out the door. Every task you handle contributes to a seamless process, ensuring customers get exactly what they need, right on time.

Along the way, you’ll also get hands-on experience with equipment like forklifts, reach trucks, and OPT systems. Never used them before? That’s no problem, comprehensive training is provided so you can quickly gain confidence and expand your skills.

Teamwork is at the heart of this role. You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues, supporting each other to hit daily targets and celebrating successes together. Accuracy and attention to detail are key, because every order counts and every customer matters.

This is more than just a warehouse role. It’s a chance to grow, learn, and become part of a dynamic environment where your contribution truly makes a difference.

Proficiency in English or Dutch is required.

- Good salary depending on your experience
- Direct contract with the employer
- Supportive working environment: training provided so you can develop your skills
- Dynamic and varied role: no two days are the same
- Career opportunities: chance to grow further in warehousing and logistics

Do you enjoy working accurately and do you have the required documents to work in the Netherlands? Then this position is for you. For Arvato in Heijen, we are looking for motivated warehouse employees who ensure that orders are correctly collected, packed and prepared for shipment. You will work in a workplace where teamwork and quality are central. In addition, you have the chance of permanent employment upon good performance. Read on!

As a warehouse employee, you ensure that orders are carefully processed. Your tasks include:

    - Order picking on the picking line
    
- Scanning items with a handheld scanner
    
- Placing items in boxes and packing them correctly
